changes.change: Correct both hands to rear/dorsal view with appropriate thumb orientation and visible nails.
prompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
The input is the BACK VIEW of a headless clothed anime character in an A-pose. Correct ONLY BOTH HANDS and their wrist transitions. The hands currently read as copied front-view/palm-side hands. They must become anatomically coherent REAR-VIEW HANDS with the BACKS OF THE HANDS FACING THE CAMERA and palms facing away toward the character's front.

At the left side of the picture is the character's LEFT hand; at the right is the character's RIGHT hand. Keep wrists at the same cuff exits and preserve the relaxed diagonal down-and-out A-pose. Redraw the hands with the correct left/right handedness:
- Show the dorsal surfaces, gentle knuckle indications, and subtle small unpainted FINGERNAILS on the backs of the fingers. This must clearly read as hand backs, never open palms.
- Four slender relaxed long fingers with correct length order plus ONE distinct shorter thumb on each hand, FIVE DIGITS PER HAND. Fingers lightly spread naturally.
- On the image-left hand, the thumb belongs on the upper/outer-left edge; on the image-right hand, the thumb belongs on the upper/outer-right edge. Do not leave the thumbs on the inner lower edge facing the torso as in the existing front-like hands.
- No palm creases, no thenar palm pads presented to camera, no webbed/merged fingers, no duplicate thumbs, no six fingers, no distorted wrist twists.

CRITICAL INVARIANTS: preserve every other part of the input image as closely as possible, including exact canvas/scale, neck connector, hood and plain coat back, sleeves and pink cuffs, shorts, tail and its pink bow/gold bell, legs, socks, slipper heels, outline, local colors, shading and transparent background. Do NOT redesign clothing, change arm angles, add a head, change the tail, or introduce text. Only the two small hand areas are edited.
Keep the same delicate pastel anime illustration style, matching original skin tone and fine line weight. Full original portrait image, clean genuine transparency, all extremities inside frame.

changes.change: Show convex outer cat-ear backs and continuous long rear hair rather than front-style ear cavities and bangs.
prompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
The provided isolated hairstyle is SUPPOSED to be a REAR VIEW, but it incorrectly shows front-facing CAT EAR INTERIORS and front-bang-like layers on the back of the head. Correct these rear-view errors while preserving the character's peach-blonde long wavy hair with pink tips and overall length.

Make the result unmistakably the true orthographic view from DIRECTLY BEHIND:
1. BOTH CAT EARS: Replace the currently visible pink cavities and white inner-ear tufts completely. We must see ONLY the CLOSED CONVEX OUTER BACK SURFACES of the ears. Each ear is a solid softly shaded peach/cream furry triangular shell with a slight rounded ridge, attached to the rear crown. ZERO pink inner-ear triangles, ZERO white inner-ear tufts, ZERO openings or ear-canal hollows. The ears still point upward/outward in the same locations and have the same outer size. They are facing AWAY from the viewer. Do not simply recolor an inner-ear cavity; make each ear surface convex and structurally read as the back of an ear.
2. BACK OF HEAD / CROWN: Remove the central front-bang/fringe construction and large short petal-like bang tips across the upper head. Replace it with the continuous rounded REAR HAIR CAP: subtle natural crown whorl at the upper rear, long smooth strand flow curving over the back of the skull and continuing DOWN into the long back hair. No front hairline, parted bangs, face-framing cavity or forehead-shaped section on the rear.
3. LOWER HAIR: Preserve the existing long full curtain of layered peach-blonde wavy locks transitioning to pastel pink at the lower third, with the existing flowing curled ends and broad silhouette. Keep it a plausible rear continuation of the same hairstyle, not a new haircut. Keep the ahoge at the top; preserve its size and direction. No hairpins are visible from this rear angle.

The entire output consists only of the hair and two cat ears, no head, skin, face, human ears, neck, body, collar, accessories, bow or mannequin. Keep the same delicate pastel anime illustration style, line weight, palette, image framing and square canvas. Maintain clear margins around every tip. Genuine transparent background and clean edges; no text, labels, watermark, extra view or collage.

Edit this REAR-VIEW hairstyle reference. The cat ear BACK surfaces are now correct: PRESERVE the two solid peach-fur ear backs exactly. Also preserve ahoge, outer hair silhouette, peach-to-pink gradient, total length and bottom curled tips.
The remaining problem is the cluster of short BANG-LIKE PETALS on the upper back of the head. Remove that entire short fringe structure and REDRAW THE UPPER AND MIDDLE HAIR INTERIOR as authentic continuous long BACK HAIR.

Design requirement:
- From the small rear crown whorl, long gently curved parallel strands flow over the rounded back of the skull and then CONTINUE ALL THE WAY DOWN into the long wavy hair.
- The upper 65 percent of the hair must have NO short pointed locks ending in midair, no oval bangs cap, no overlapping petal-shaped fringe tips, no forehead bangs, no face-opening outline. Internal lines in this area are thin continuous flowing strand boundaries, not the terminal edges of short layers.
- Keep broad soft S-waves through the middle; strands finally separate into the existing long curled pink tips in the bottom third. A complete coherent curtain of waist-length rear hair, not front bangs pasted on a filled-in face.
- You may redraw all interior linework of the upper and middle hair to achieve this. Keep the recognizable exterior shape and palette and the correctly rear-facing ears invariant.

Strict direct BACK view only. No pink ear interiors, no white inner-ear tufts, no hairpins, no human face/head/skin, no body, no collar, no new accessories. Same delicate pastel anime shading and line weight; square transparent canvas, same framing, clean edges, no text or diagrams.
